levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: «مسندا إلى أبي جعفر» ends the chain inside the chain itself, after «عن» and not in the words of the saying, so the Imam is a narrator here, not imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); flagged for the archive's review of the Imami rule
«رضي الله عنه» and «عليه السلام» are blessings, left out; the surface «عبدالرحمن» is kept without a space as written
